title: Andhra Pradesh civic polls largely peaceful; Jagan demands repoll in Pulivendula after clashes
description: Polling across 13 municipal corporations and 79 municipalities and nagar panchayats ends amid sporadic violence. The SEC puts the overall polling percentage at 48.03 by 3 p.m., reports 275 FIRs in connection with 40 incidents and says repolling, if required, will be held on November 2
